evidenceKind: local public-source correctness and controlled-fault checks
scope: Scoped signal ownership and deferred native JSX contracts.
limitations: These are local correctness checks, not performance measurements or CI results.
Commands record the exact local staging paths used. Harness hashes identify those temporary configurations; the staging environment must be recreated to rerun elsewhere.
No raw heap snapshots, private comparison material, credentials, or third-party private source are included.

The engine fault-focused subset has 112 tests. Deferred JSX has 14 tests repeated under development, production, and strong compiler modes for the positive run; each fault runs the 14 development cases.
Compiler-only metadata and directive roots retain their existing compiled-fragment descriptor ABI; the ordinary host tests protect inspectable authored type and props.
